metadata.analysis: exact central-goal reachability and dynamic programming; no beam pruning
metadata.solutionDefinition: ordered sequences of coordinate jumps; symmetric sequences and different move orders are distinct
metadata.solutionCountNote: decimal string; capped=true means >= cap; log10 and approximate count use floating-point DP
metadata.routePolicy: uniform choice among winning moves at each state; expected sums divided by pegCount-1; terminal excluded
metadata.puzzleIndexNote: zero-based index in the original per-peg array

formulaVariables.P: win probability when choosing uniformly among ALL legal moves
formulaVariables.F: expected count of states with winning=1 and legal>1 under routePolicy

metadata.calibration: provisional heuristic, not validated against human play data
metadata.starThresholdStatus: provisional common-scale thresholds, not per-peg quantiles; no star labels assigned
